Artists/Folk Gouache & Naïve Art/Tomokazu Komiya

Tomokazu Komiya’sPlayfully Askew

Tomokazu Komiya uses raw, expressive gouache brushstrokes and intentionally warped perspectives to capture Pokémon in chaotic, humorous everyday moments. Each illustration feels alive with energetic spontaneity and folk-art honesty.
